title: Aralo snippet front matter (format v0)
description: The YAML block between the two `---` lines at the top of a snippet file (`*.md`). The body that follows the closing `---` is not described here; see docs/format/snippet.md. Every key is optional. A key left out of `trigger`, `case`, `word` or `keep_delimiter` inherits from the group. Unknown keys are accepted and written back unchanged. An empty block is valid. Format v0 is pre-release and may change without a migration.
$comment: Mirrors `FrontMatter` in crates/aralo-snippet/src/snippet.rs. When the two disagree, the Rust code wins; please report it.

id.description: The snippet's identity: a ULID that survives renames and moves. Hand-written files may leave it out; Aralo assigns one on the first save. Aralo writes upper case; lower case is accepted on read.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in lists and search. Default: empty.

abbr.description: The abbreviation or abbreviations that expand this snippet. A single string is accepted on read; Aralo always writes a list. A snippet with no abbreviation is reachable through search only. The engine rejects an abbreviation that is empty or longer than 63 characters (Unicode scalar values); see docs/format/matching.md.

type.description: What kind of snippet this is. Default: `text`.

trigger.description: `immediate`: expand as soon as the last character of the abbreviation is typed. `delimiter`: expand when a delimiter is typed after it. Absent or null: inherit from the group; the built-in default is `delimiter`.

case.description: `exact`: the abbreviation must be typed exactly as defined. `ignore`: any case matches and the expansion is unchanged. `adaptive`: any case matches and the typed pattern (as defined, Title, UPPER) re-cases the expansion. Absent or null: inherit; the built-in default is `adaptive`.

word.description: Whole-word rule: expand only when the character before the abbreviation is not a word character (alphanumeric or `_`). Absent or null: inherit; the built-in default is `true`.

keep_delimiter.description: Re-insert the delimiter that triggered the expansion, after the expansion. Only read for `trigger: delimiter`. Absent or null: inherit; the built-in default is `true`.

enabled.description: `false` switches this snippet off. Absent or null: enabled, unless a group above it is disabled.

tags.description: Free-form tags for search and filtering. Default: none.

ai.description: What an AI block in this snippet may see and which provider profile runs it (PRD P4). Absent or null: the snippet declares no context.

ulid.description: A ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32 (digits and letters without I, L, O and U).

context.description: Context kinds the snippet declares. Nothing else may be requested from the shell or sent to a model. The plan names `fillins`, `selection`, `clipboard`, `app` and `window`; this version stores the strings without checking them.

profile.description: Name of the provider profile to use. Profiles live outside the library folder. Absent or null: the profile chosen in settings.
